resources.string: Ready when you are. Tap Start to translate.
The glasses microphone was unavailable. Using the phone microphone instead.
Camera enhancement is unavailable. Audio translation can continue.
Add an Alibaba API key for the selected region in API settings, then try again.
Microphone permission is required. Tap Start to allow access, or enable it in Android app settings.
The microphone connection changed or is in use. Translation stopped. Check your audio connection, then tap Start to retry.
Translation could not continue. Check your connection and Alibaba settings, then tap Start to retry.
While translation runs, audio and optional glasses camera frames are sent to Alibaba. Leaving this page stops translation. Text history stays only in app memory.
Up to 50 stopped sessions, kept only in memory.
Changes apply the next time you tap Start. This page does not activate a microphone or camera.
The current source language is not available as a spoken target.
Only voices compatible with the target language can be selected.
Play translated speech as well as showing text.
Share occasional glasses camera frames while translating to provide visual context. Requires camera permission.
When off, try the glasses microphone first and use the phone if it is unavailable.
